column2: ‘“accessible format” means a copy of a work in an
alternative  form  or  manner  which  gives  a
beneficiary  person  access  to  such  work,
including to permit such person to have access
as  feasibly  and  comfortably  as  a  person
without  any  disability  which  a  beneficiary
person has. The accessible format copy shall
be  used  exclusively  by  beneficiary  persons
and shall respect the intergrity of the original
work, taking into consideration of the changes
needed  to  make  the  work  accessible  in  the
alternative  format  and  of  the  accessibility
